marker_reviews.reason: This dynamic statement builds an ON COMMIT DROP temporary probe table inside the migration's own self-verification DO block, copying the live business_path CHECK definition read from pg_constraint. It creates no durable object, alters no persistent schema, and leaves nothing behind after the transaction, so there is no post-apply catalog state a durable check could observe.

This dynamic statement inserts probe values into that same ON COMMIT DROP temporary table to observe whether the copied business_path CHECK accepts or rejects each value. It writes only to transient temporary storage that disappears at commit, touches no durable relation, and therefore has no persistent post-apply state for a hash-bound check to assert.

This dynamic statement builds a second ON COMMIT DROP temporary probe table carrying the live sample_workflow_valid_flow_path CHECK definition so the workflow_type and business_path matrix can be exercised in full. It creates no durable object and vanishes at commit, leaving no persistent catalog target for a durable check.
